'''Cloud Obliterator''' is an [[Elite enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A criminal equipped with heavy weaponry. Obliteration is no small feat. Only the strongest smashers armed with quadruple rocket launchers can achieve the title of Cloud Obliterator.}}
